annotations.title: Read the engine's live track record

description: Cybergenic's live track record: how many predictions it has locked in its hash-chained registry before re-testing them, how many replicated in an independent cohort against matched controls (including the less-studied-pair subset), and how many findings currently pass every check as both strong and overlooked. Read it before describing how reliable the engine is; it states its own limits, including whether the replication comes from well-known biology.
